title: 操控设计不直观且缺乏说明
description: 游戏操控方式复杂、不直观，缺乏有效引导，导致玩家难以理解或误操作，包括导航、交互、快捷键等。
evidence: The way you interact with things is unintuitive.
I cannot describe how badly the ship navigation controls in this game are designed and explained
this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information

evidence_items.quote: this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information
evidence_items.description: 轨道导航感觉不响应、难以操作且缺乏信息。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏想尽一切办法让轨道导航和机动操作感觉迟钝、别扭且缺乏信息。

evidence_items.quote: the complex controls and mechanics you need to learn can be one of the main reasons new players might not play this again
evidence_items.description: 复杂的操控和机制需要学习，可能让新玩家不愿再玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你需要学习的复杂操作和机制，可能是新玩家不会再玩这个游戏的主要原因之一

evidence_items.quote: The click to select on the Nav Station doesn't feel user friendly. Click and drag should be considered movement, clicking to move the frame was confusing.
evidence_items.description: 导航站点击选择不友好，点击拖动被当作移动，点击移动框架令人困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在导航站上点击选择感觉并不友好。点击并拖动应该被视为移动，点击来移动框架令人困惑。

evidence_items.quote: The way you interact with things is unintuitive.
evidence_items.description: 与物体交互的方式不直观。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你和事物互动的方式很不直观。

evidence_items.quote: I cannot describe how badly the ship navigation controls in this game are designed and explained
evidence_items.description: 飞船导航操控设计极差且缺乏说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我无法形容这款游戏中的飞船导航控制设计和解说得有多糟糕
